fix.change: InitWindow and GSSharedPresent::CaptureHostContext before syncCoreSubsystems, then RestoreHostContext. UploadFrame draws the acquired shared texture unless input-lag hashing or 90 missed latches, and falls through to readback. presentHostFrame applies F2 filter, aspect and the FXAA/sharpen shader to that texture. [present] log under TEKKEN4_HUD_LOG.
usesSharedPresentation(); copyLatchedHostPresentationFrame does Present forceReadback when the shared path stored no pixels, so frame shots and the stage picker still get a bitmap.
PublishSharedTexture allocates the slot NEAREST so F2 smooth can turn on bilinear from the host.
